tieu_de: Engineering Manager Digital Banking / Fintech Product
yeu_cau:
Experience & Background:
10+ years of working experience in Software Development.
4+ years of experience leading an engineering organization at a product company (preferred).
Experience in a management position at an international finance or tech company, with a strong development background.
Experience in the Banking or Financial Services industry is preferred.
Technical Skills:
Solid experience with Microservices (REST API) and databases (MySQL, MongoDB).
Deep understanding of AWS (Lambda, S3, API Gateway, CLI, ECS, EKS, etc.) OR Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a MUST.
Deep understanding of Software Quality, DevOps environments, and CI/CD/build processes.
Proven experience implementing software engineering methodologies (Agile, Scrum, SDLC, coding standards, SCM).
Ability to produce technical documentation (specifications, operating instructions, test plans).
Leadership & Soft Skills:
Strong people leadership, team building, motivation, coaching, and mentoring skills.
Proven track record of working with cross-functional teams and coordinating efforts in a distributed environment.
Experience working with multiple stakeholders across different countries with conflicting priorities.
Ability to initiate design and implement new product lines end-to-end.
